# Prakash S. Jain & Co.

> Prakash S. Jain & Co. is a Chartered Accountant firm in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India, in practice for more than 39 years. Partner CA Shreya Jain (CA, CS, LL.B., FAFD) handles income tax compliance, income tax assessments and appeals, tax planning for domestic and foreign clients, company incorporation and secretarial work, RBI compliances and forensic audit.

## Key facts
- Firm: Prakash S. Jain & Co., Chartered Accountants
- Address: 319/320, Manas Bhavan, R.N.T. Marg, Indore, Madhya Pradesh 452001, India
- Phone: +91 98260 52751
- Partner: CA Shreya Jain, Partner since September 2016; qualifications CA (ICAI), CS (ICSI), LL.B., FAFD (ICAI)
- Clients: individuals, families, businesses, companies, NRIs and foreign clients

## Pages
- [Home](https://prekshabarjatya.github.io/ca-site/): overview of the firm
- [CA Shreya Jain](https://prekshabarjatya.github.io/ca-site/ca-shreya-jain/): partner profile and qualifications
- [Services](https://prekshabarjatya.github.io/ca-site/services/): all services
- [Income Tax Compliance](https://prekshabarjatya.github.io/ca-site/services/income-tax/): Corporate and personal tax returns, advance tax, TDS and tax audit for individuals, firms and companies.
- [Assessments & Appeals](https://prekshabarjatya.github.io/ca-site/services/assessments-appeals/): Replies to notices, scrutiny and faceless assessments, and appeals before CIT(A) and the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal.
- [Tax Planning & Foreign Tax](https://prekshabarjatya.github.io/ca-site/services/tax-planning-foreign-tax/): Tax planning for domestic and foreign clients, DTAA relief, residential status and certification of foreign remittances.
- [Company Incorporation & Secretarial](https://prekshabarjatya.github.io/ca-site/services/company-incorporation-secretarial/): Company and LLP incorporation, ROC annual filings, board and shareholder compliance and changes in directors or capital.
- [RBI & FEMA Compliance](https://prekshabarjatya.github.io/ca-site/services/rbi-fema-compliance/): Foreign investment reporting, overseas investment, ECB and the RBI filings that follow when money crosses borders.
- [Forensic Audit](https://prekshabarjatya.github.io/ca-site/services/forensic-audit/): Investigation of suspected fraud, diversion of funds and accounting irregularities, with reports that can stand in a dispute.
- [Audit & Assurance](https://prekshabarjatya.github.io/ca-site/services/audit-assurance/): Statutory audit of companies, tax audit, and audits of trusts, societies and firms.
- [GST](https://prekshabarjatya.github.io/ca-site/services/gst/): Registration, returns, input tax credit reconciliation, annual returns and replies to department notices.
- [Contact](https://prekshabarjatya.github.io/ca-site/contact/): address, phone and enquiry form

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Which Chartered Accountant firm in Indore handles income tax appeals?
  A: Prakash S. Jain & Co. has been in practice in Indore for more than 39 years. Partner CA Shreya Jain (CA, CS, LL.B., FAFD) handles income tax assessments and appeals before the Commissioner (Appeals) and the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal.
- Q: What services does Prakash S. Jain & Co. offer?
  A: Income tax compliance, income tax assessments and appeals, tax planning and foreign tax advisory, company incorporation and secretarial work, RBI and FEMA compliance, forensic audit, audit and assurance, and GST.
- Q: Where is the office of Prakash S. Jain & Co.?
  A: The office is at 319/320, Manas Bhavan, R.N.T. Marg, Indore, Madhya Pradesh 452001. You can reach it by phone at +91 98260 52751.
- Q: Does the firm work with NRIs and foreign clients?
  A: Yes. The firm advises domestic and foreign clients on tax planning, NRI taxation, DTAA relief, Form 15CA / 15CB and RBI / FEMA compliance for foreign investment.
- Q: What qualifications does CA Shreya Jain hold?
  A: CA Shreya Jain is a Chartered Accountant (ICAI), a Company Secretary (ICSI), holds a Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.) and has completed ICAI's Forensic Accounting and Fraud Detection (FAFD) certification.
